How to use La Case des Savoirs

Readers who want practical books on community development, eco tourism, farming, A-frame building and African innovation, in French and English, and authors who want to publish chapter by chapter.

Open La Case des Savoirs →Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open terra-village-reads.lovable.app and press Explorer les livres.

2

Search a book, a chapter or a subject in the search box.

3

Open a book and start reading; the reader keeps your place.

4

Create an account to bookmark, highlight and take notes.

5

Subscribe for the full shelf when you need more than the featured books.

02Room by room

What is inside, and how to use it.

01The library

The library

Featured books and the full shelf, by theme, with search across chapters.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Browse by theme
  2. Search a word
  3. Open a book
  4. Add it to your shelf
02The reader

The reader

A calm reading room with adjustable modes, bookmarks, highlights and notes. Your progress follows your account.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Choose a reading mode
  2. Highlight a passage
  3. Write a note
  4. Come back where you left off
03Subscription

Subscription

One subscription opens the whole shelf.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open Abonnement
  2. Choose the plan
  3. Pay
  4. Read everything
04Submit a project

Submit a project

Authors and communities can propose a book or a manual; the admin dashboard publishes chapter by chapter.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Press Soumettre un projet
  2. Describe the book
  3. Send the chapters
  4. Follow the publication
03Tips
  • Books are chapters, so they load fast on a weak connection.
  • Highlights and notes are the real value; use them.
  • French first, English one tap away.
  • Propose a book; the library grows from its readers.
04FAQ
Is it free?

Featured books are free to read. The full shelf needs a subscription.

Can I read offline?

The reader is a web app; it works best with a connection.

Who publishes?

Authors and communities, through the submit door and the admin dashboard.

Which languages?

French and English.
